characterDescription: Punk zine sticker nav: height compressed to 20px, zero horizontal padding — strips away all breathing room. Oswald 700 at 0.65rem with heavy 0.12em letter-spacing reads like text stamped on a zine header. No background, no scroll transition, no dropdown. Just a xerox-strip of all-caps condensed type slapped across the top of the page. Item spacing 24px creates deliberate crowding.

_twist.description: Ultra-compact 20px height, zero padding, Oswald 700 at 0.65rem with 0.12em tracking — reads like a zine masthead. No background, no scroll effects, no dropdown. Maximum compression.
_twist.checkCFix: JetBrains Mono not present in assembled type system (has Oswald + IBM Plex Mono). fontFamily changed to 'Oswald', sans-serif — Oswald IS present as ds-font-family-display/heading.
